prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1189; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection on a green signal when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by a second vehicle, operated by Driver 2, which entered from a cross street. Responding officers observed that the damage to both vehicles was consistent with a broadside collision of this type and force. Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel at the time of impact, and this was confirmed by the arriving officers, by independent witnesses at the scene, and by Driver 2, who stated that the sequence of events occurred as Driver 1 described. A Passenger was also present in the front seat and was not injured in the collision. Driver 1 reported pain and swelling to the left wrist and was transported for evaluation, where the reported injury was described as a fracture consistent with the mechanism of the crash. Photographs taken at the scene were reviewed and show no prior damage to the vehicle's driver-side panels or frame. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No further contributing factors were identified at the scene.
